name: Southside Data Centre
developer: Sunlaws Development Company Limited / Roxburghe Estate
notes: Proposed data centre near Duns/Longformacus in the Scottish Borders; public consultation materials describe a 225 MW digital hub, and public notice/ITV identify Sunlaws Development Company and the Clawbare Cottage/Longformacus site.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Apatura Coldstream Data Centre Campus
notes: Proposed 300 MW data centre campus with BESS near Coldstream/Laundry Field in the Scottish Borders; public sources indicate early planning/screening rather than construction.

United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Freeport Data Centre Campus
notes: Apatura consultation materials describe a proposed 250 MW sustainably designed data campus plus 250 MW BESS at Freeport Leisure Village/Westwood, north west of West Calder in West Lothian; APRS cites PAC 0625/PAC/25.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Linlithgow Campus data centre
notes: Former Oracle/Sun Linlithgow data centre site. Marketing brochure says Oracle previously operated the on-site data centre, certificate of lawfulness covers data centre use, and existing supply is 6.8 MW with 4 MW currently available; The Register reported in 2021 that Oracle planned to close the facility, so current operating status is uncertain.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Prosperity Parc data centre campus
notes: Stena Line-owned Anglesey Land Holdings received outline approval for the Prosperity Parc redevelopment at the former Anglesey Aluminium/Penrhos site, including about 2.5m sq ft of data centre space and a 349 MW BESS; data-centre IT load not separately stated in public summaries.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Carbon3.ai Amlwch Port AI data centre
notes: Proposal to convert the former Octel factory at Amlwch Port into an AI data centre was rejected by Anglesey County Council in April 2026; no MW capacity found in public reports.

United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Vantage Bridgend data centre campus
notes: Vantage plan for former Ford engine plant at Bridgend approved unanimously by council committee on 2025-10-02; public reporting describes up to 10 data centre buildings over 15-20 years, and Senedd research cites around 600 MW planned capacity.

name: Latos Cardiff hyperscale data centre
notes: Approved hyperscale facility at Land at Rover Way, Splott/Tremorfa, Cardiff; council report describes 50,400 sq m data centre, and Latos/industry reports cite 90 MVA/MW and construction/enabling works.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Cardiff East Park and Ride / Llanrumney data centre campus
notes: Hybrid planning application by Curtis Hall Limited for redevelopment of Cardiff East Park and Ride, Llanrumney/Pentwyn, into a data centre campus; Senedd research cites one Cardiff planned development at 150 MW, matching public reports of the Llanrumney proposal.
